{{Top|leg}}
'''K'va't'uuk''' was the [[Sebiri]] [[Sebiri language|term]] for "holy ground" or "forbidden land." The [[stone temple]] located neared one of the [[Sebiri village]]s was considered to be off-limits to outsider by the Sebiri.
